alt_key.description: whether the key is a system key

ctrl_key.description: whether the ctrl key is pressed

key_code.description:
Legacy browser/Windows virtual-key code, e.g. 65 for "a". This is not a Linux evdev code.
See https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/API/KeyboardEvent/keyCode

location.description: location of the key on the keyboard

meta_key.description: whether the meta key is pressed

shift_key.description: whether the shift key is pressed
